references.text: Gath-Rimmon is mentioned as a Levitical city given to the sons of Kohath from the tribe of Dan, showing that the city was later assigned to the Levites.
In Chronicles, Gath-Rimmon is also mentioned as a Levitical city, confirming the city's significance in Israel's history.
The entire passage describes the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, where Jehud, Bene-Berak, and Gath-Rimmon are among the cities assigned to them.
